cpu_active_tap_strict_pct.label: active CPU, 20 strict counter taps
cpu_active_tap_strict_pct.method: utime+stime delta over the serve tree during the M8 strict counter cohort (20 taps, ~20 s)
cpu_active_tap_strict_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n10_pct.label: idle CPU, N=10
cpu_idle_n10_pct.method: same 60 s utime+stime window at N=10
cpu_idle_n10_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n10_per_session_pct.label: idle CPU per session, N=10
cpu_idle_n10_per_session_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n1_pct.label: idle CPU, N=1
cpu_idle_n1_pct.method: /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime over a 60 s idle window, summed over the serve tree (guests included)
cpu_idle_n1_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n1_per_session_pct.label: idle CPU per session, N=1
cpu_idle_n1_per_session_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n5_pct.label: idle CPU, N=5
cpu_idle_n5_pct.method: same 60 s utime+stime window at N=5
cpu_idle_n5_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

cpu_idle_n5_per_session_pct.label: idle CPU per session, N=5
cpu_idle_n5_per_session_pct.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n1_ms.label: full agent loop latency, N=1
loop_n1_ms.method: P5 loop: launch->tree->find->tap->settle->screenshot->verify->reset; sum of the 7 request walls per verified task
loop_n1_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n1_tasks_per_gib_min.label: verified tasks/GiB-min, N=1
loop_n1_tasks_per_gib_min.method: verified tasks / cgroup GiB-min integral (benchlib.sample_integral) over the cohort
loop_n1_tasks_per_gib_min.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n1_tasks_per_s.label: verified tasks/s, N=1
loop_n1_tasks_per_s.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n1_verified_rate.label: verified task rate, N=1
loop_n1_verified_rate.method: verified tasks / measured tasks in the P5 loop (1.0 required for a fully reliable loop; a failure is not a false pass)
loop_n1_verified_rate.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n5_ms.label: full agent loop latency, N=5
loop_n5_ms.method: same P5 loop with 5 concurrent sessions in one serve
loop_n5_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n5_tasks_per_gib_min.label: verified tasks/GiB-min, N=5
loop_n5_tasks_per_gib_min.method: verified tasks / cgroup GiB-min integral, 5 concurrent sessions
loop_n5_tasks_per_gib_min.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n5_tasks_per_s.label: verified tasks/s, N=5
loop_n5_tasks_per_s.method: verified tasks / cohort wall, 5 concurrent sessions
loop_n5_tasks_per_s.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

loop_n5_verified_rate.label: verified task rate, N=5
loop_n5_verified_rate.method: verified tasks / measured tasks, 5 concurrent sessions
loop_n5_verified_rate.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m1_idle_mem_mib.label: M1 idle memory, 1 app
m1_idle_mem_mib.method: cgroup v2 memory.stat anon+shmem (job scope + guest scopes, sampler's own anon+shmem charged back), 60 s after first frame, N=1
m1_idle_mem_mib.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m1_idle_pss_mib.label: M1 idle memory, 1 app (Pss)
m1_idle_pss_mib.method: sum of Pss over the serve process tree (smaps_rollup), 60 s after first frame, N=1; shared pages divided by mapping count
m1_idle_pss_mib.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n1.label: M2 memory per extra session, N=1
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n1.method: (cgroup anon+shmem N=1 - bare daemon) / 1, 60 s idle
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n1.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n10.label: M2 memory per extra session, N=10
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n10.method: (cgroup anon+shmem N=10 - bare daemon) / 10, 60 s idle
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n10.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n5.label: M2 memory per extra session, N=5
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n5.method: (cgroup anon+shmem N=5 - bare daemon) / 5, 60 s idle
m2_per_session_anon_shmem_n5.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_pss_n1.label: M2 Pss per session, N=1
m2_per_session_pss_n1.method: (system-wide sum Pss of the session tree - bare daemon Pss) / 1; Pss divides a shared page by mapping count, so at N=1 the single session carries the whole boot-image/framework file share
m2_per_session_pss_n1.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_pss_n10.label: M2 Pss per session, N=10
m2_per_session_pss_n10.method: (sum Pss of sessions - bare daemon Pss) / 10; see M2 Pss N=1
m2_per_session_pss_n10.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m2_per_session_pss_n5.label: M2 Pss per session, N=5
m2_per_session_pss_n5.method: (sum Pss of sessions - bare daemon Pss) / 5; see M2 Pss N=1
m2_per_session_pss_n5.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m3_cold_start_ms.label: M3 cold start -> first correct screen
m3_cold_start_ms.method: nothing running, page cache evicted per rep (posix_fadvise, fincore-proved) -> spawn acos serve -> acos_launch -> reply tree is count=0 and a following strict tree still reads 0
m3_cold_start_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m4_launch_fast_ms.label: M4 warm launch (fast)
m4_launch_fast_ms.method: acos_launch settle=fast (probe-fresh label recorded) -> reply tree count=0 + post-frame strict tree count=0
m4_launch_fast_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m4_launch_strict_ms.label: M4 warm launch (strict)
m4_launch_strict_ms.method: warm daemon, app not running -> acos_launch settle=strict -> reply tree count=0 + post-frame strict tree count=0; destroy between reps
m4_launch_strict_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m5_screenshot_ms.label: M5 fresh screenshot (PNG)
m5_screenshot_ms.method: acos_observe {png:true} on a held session; PNG magic + newer frame_seq + meaningful frame required
m5_screenshot_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m6_reset_fast_ms.label: M6 reset -> first correct screen (fast)
m6_reset_fast_ms.method: acos_reset settle=fast; state_reset + data_cleared + count=0 in the reply and in a following strict tree
m6_reset_fast_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m6_reset_strict_ms.label: M6 reset -> first correct screen (strict)
m6_reset_strict_ms.method: count=1 strictly read -> acos_reset settle=strict -> reply tree count=0 + following strict tree count=0
m6_reset_strict_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m7_tree_fast_ms.label: M7 UI tree with text (fast)
m7_tree_fast_ms.method: acos_observe_tree settle=fast; the fast tree must show the same count text as a strict read (no stale tree)
m7_tree_fast_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m7_tree_strict_ms.label: M7 UI tree with text (strict)
m7_tree_strict_ms.method: acos_observe_tree settle=strict on a held session; tree has nodes and text, not truncated
m7_tree_strict_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m8_tap_counter_fast_ms.label: M8 tap -> settled, counter (fast)
m8_tap_counter_fast_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m8_tap_counter_strict_ms.label: M8 tap -> settled, counter (strict)
m8_tap_counter_strict_ms.method: acos_tap {id:inc} settle=strict on counter, one session; every tap must report state_changed and the final strict count must equal the tap count
m8_tap_counter_strict_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m8_tap_form_fast_ms.label: M8 tap -> settled, form (fast)
m8_tap_form_fast_ms.method: empty form, tap submit settle=fast; same strict post-check
m8_tap_form_fast_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

m8_tap_form_strict_ms.label: M8 tap -> settled, form (strict)
m8_tap_form_strict_ms.method: empty form, tap submit settle=strict; following strict tree must read error='Name is required'; fast reset (unmeasured) before each rep
m8_tap_form_strict_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

p11_false_passes.label: P11 settle-lab false passes
p11_false_passes.method: P11 method: strict reply followed immediately by a fast tree and a frame-only capture; a settled reply whose state is not final is a false pass (0 required)
p11_false_passes.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

p11_scenarios_failed.label: p11-*.yaml scenarios failed
p11_scenarios_failed.method: scenarios/p11-*.yaml through acos verify --engine art; every expectation:pass scenario must pass (0 required)
p11_scenarios_failed.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

tap_ack_ms.label: tap acknowledgement (settle.ack_ms)
tap_ack_ms.method: input ack latency reported in the tap reply's settle block (counter + form, strict and fast)
tap_ack_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

teardown_ms.label: acos_destroy teardown_ms (GL1)
teardown_ms.method: reply teardown.teardown_ms for a live counter session (lifecycle label recorded); 20 samples
teardown_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

teardown_wall_ms.label: acos_destroy wall
teardown_wall_ms.method: client wall of acos_destroy incl. teardown evidence
teardown_wall_ms.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

wakeups_idle_n10_per_s.label: idle wakeups/s, N=10
wakeups_idle_n10_per_s.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

wakeups_idle_n1_per_s.label: idle wakeups/s, N=1
wakeups_idle_n1_per_s.method: voluntary_ctxt_switches delta over the 60 s idle window, summed over the serve tree; proxy for wakeups (perf unavailable)
wakeups_idle_n1_per_s.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

wakeups_idle_n5_per_s.label: idle wakeups/s, N=5
wakeups_idle_n5_per_s.rule: max(min_pct, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a regression must exceed both threshold_pct and threshold_abs

notes: value = p50 pooled over every sample in every rep; p95 pooled the same way; per-rep p50s are kept for the threshold derivation.
threshold = max(category floor, 2 x worst rep-to-rep deviation), capped at 40 %; a delta must exceed both the relative and the absolute threshold to be called a regression.
memory rows are label-matched (cgroup anon+shmem vs Pss); they are never mixed.
M3 is measured with the launch working set evicted per rep; the warm-cache variant is M4 + daemon spawn (P7).
